- a big number: trouser m times 100 rounded divided by 100, labelled "m trouser".
- a big number: 2.5, labelled "m dupatta".

Fever Check, in the red colours.
Works out:
- c is t when scale is Celsius, otherwise the result of t minus 32 times 5 divided by 9.
Remembers while you use it: t, starting at 38.2; scale, starting at Celsius.
Shows:
- a box to fill in t, labelled "Temperature".
- a choice of scale.
- a card with a big number c times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled "degrees C =" roundc * 9 / 5 + 32 * 10 / 10 "F", with a ring toward 40 when there is one.
- if c is less than 35:
  - text: "Low. Warm up and recheck.".
- if c is at least 35 and c is less than 37.5:
  - text: "Normal range.".
- if c is at least 37.5 and c is less than 39:
  - text: "Fever. Rest, fluids, recheck in a few hours.".
- if c is at least 39:
  - text: "High fever. Call a doctor.".

- mins is kg times 45 when how is Oven, otherwise 35 when how is Airfryer, otherwise 30 plus 20 when how is Oven, otherwise 10 rounded.

- text: "Put it in at", begin divided by 60 rounded down, ":", "0" when begin leaves over when divided by 60 is less than 10, otherwise "", begin leaves over when divided by 60.
- text: "Oven 45 min per kg plus 20, air fryer 35 per kg plus 10, pot 30 per kg plus 10. Check it is cooked through.".

- a card with a big number bmi times 10 rounded divided by 10, labelled band, with a ring toward 25 when there is one.
- a card titled "Healthy range for your height" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.

- tb is loan divided by n when rb is 0, otherwise loan times rb divided by 1200 times the pow of 1 plus rb divided by 1200 divided by the result of the pow of 1 plus rb divided by 1200 minus 1 times n plus loan times fb divided by 100.

- if loan is more than 0:
  - a card with a big number ta minus tb without its sign rounded, labelled "cheaper at Bank A" when ta is at most tb, otherwise "cheaper at Bank B", with a ring toward 0 when there is one.
  - a big number: emi of ra rounded, labelled "Bank A per month".
  - a big number: emi of rb rounded, labelled "Bank B per month".
- otherwise:
  - text: "Type the loan amount to compare the banks.".

describe:
Zakat check, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- paid: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- wealth is cash plus bank plus gold times gold rate minus owed.
- nisab is 612.36 times silver rate when basis is Silver, otherwise 87.48 times gold rate.
- due is wealth times 0.025 when nisab is more than 0 and wealth is at least nisab, otherwise 0.
Remembers while you use it: cash, starting at 0; bank, starting at 0; gold, starting at 0; owed, starting at 0; gold rate, starting at 0; silver rate, starting at 0; basis, starting at Silver.
Shows:
- text: "Zakat check".
- a card titled "What you hold" with "" on the right, holding the lines under it.
